decisions.reason: The burner component supports the core gas radiant-heater business, costs little to keep, and has no signs of failure, so management keeps it.

The multi-model electric panel line is a publicly presented flagship of the electrification direction, so sunk investment and visible commitment keep it in place despite the earlier withdrawal of the industrial electric hall line.

The halogen heater is less central and somewhat exposed after Product D's withdrawal, but it still extends the electric infrared range and weak uptake can be blamed on the early market phase, so management keeps it for now.

The hydrogen-capable dark heater series is the publicly showcased core of the announced low-carbon strategy, so management will persist and treat slow hydrogen uptake as a temporary infrastructure issue.
